# ---- EXEMPLE ----

```{r}

# Config
config_list <- list(m = "GH",
                    l = "Family",
                    n = "Fabaceae",
                    from_csv = FALSE,
                    total = FALSE)

# Filters
filter_list <- list(
  filter_plant = FALSE,
  filter_monocot = FALSE,
  filter_na_family = FALSE,
  filter_na_sp = FALSE,
  filter_valid_sp = FALSE
)
grid_fam <- genet_grid_read(
  config = config_list,
  filters = filter_list
)
plot_grid(grid_fam,"OTU")

# Fabaceae all filters
filter_list <- list(
  filter_plant = TRUE,
  filter_monocot = TRUE,
  filter_na_family = TRUE,
  filter_na_sp = TRUE,
  filter_valid_sp = TRUE
)
grid_fam <- genet_grid_read(
  m = "GH",
  l = "Family",
  n = "Fabaceae",
  from_csv = FALSE,
  total = FALSE,
  filters = filter_list
)
plot_grid(grid_fam,"OTU")


filter_list <- list(
  filter_plant = FALSE,
  filter_monocot = FALSE,
  filter_na_family = FALSE,
  filter_na_sp = FALSE,
  filter_valid_sp = FALSE
)

patch_compare(var_bota = "H1",
              var_genet = "H1",
              b_grid = bota_grid_H1(select_tax(bota,
                                               Level = "Family",
                                               Name= "All"),
                                    R = 10),
              g_grid = genet_grid_read(m = "GH",
                                        l = "Family",
                                        n = "All",
                                        from_csv = FALSE,
                                        rarefied = FALSE,
                                        filters = filter_list,
                                        total = FALSE),
              b_f    = select_tax(bota,
                                  Level = "Family",
                                  Name= "All"),
              stems  = FALSE,
              Title = "Comparaison du nombre de Hill (q=1) de l'inventaire botanique et de l'inventaire génétique pour les dicots (reads non raréfiés)"
              )


filter_list <- list(
  filter_plant = TRUE,
  filter_monocot = TRUE,
  filter_na_family = TRUE,
  filter_na_sp = TRUE,
  filter_valid_sp = TRUE
)

patch_turbo_family(var="OTU",
                   filters = filter_list
                   )

# Familly Percent (filter to Family identified)

  filter_plant = TRUE,
  filter_monocot = TRUE,
  filter_na_family = TRUE,
  filter_na_sp = FALSE,
  filter_valid_sp = FALSE
)
```
